name: MosaicDissolveSlides
job: Move between slides with a WebGL pixel-displacement dissolve that radiates outward from the click point
visitor_action: click arrows or the image; swipe on touch; a quiet pause control stops auto-advance
mobile: smaller max block size, swipe advances
motion: shader mosaic: pixel blocks swell then shrink as a wave radiates from the click point (centre for keyboard/auto), swapping slide A for B; seamless, no grid lines; reduced-motion or no-WebGL: static crossfade, no auto-advance in reduced-motion
art_direction: Modern digital: ink #0c0d0f, paper #ecebe6, one signal #c8ff3a (progress/focus only); Space Grotesk 500 with one oversized counter; real fragment-shader dissolve on a canvas, no bezel or grid, segmented progress
